# Test fixtures

|---|---|---|
| `exchange-sample1.xml` | Archi Open Exchange test files (`org.opengroup.archimate.xmlexchange.tests`), via [archi-online](https://github.com/ThomasRohde/archi-online/tree/607de3b00516555fe5cf5e8335812e8e4d85f9a4/tests/fixtures) | MIT, © Phillip Beauvoir, Jean-Baptiste Sarrodie, The Open Group |

The main regression model is `resources/Arhchimateexample.xml` (a BizzDesign export). These two are Archi exports:
- one model with no views
- one view whose connections carry `sourceAttachment` and `targetAttachment`. BizzDesign exports don't include these.
